title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Gin Admin…
description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Gin Admin Theme allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects Gin Admin Theme versions: from 0.0.0 to 4.1.4, from 5.0.0 to 5.0.16.
